questions.question:
**Direction: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. The so-called harmless activities of a small number of people are increasingly becoming a serious problem for the internet.

B. You would have seen an increasing amount of 'junk mail' showing up in your email box.

C. It is basically electronic junk mail or junk newsgroup postings.

D. Spam is the flooding of the internet with many copies of the same message, in an attempt to force the message on people who would not otherwise choose to receive it.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "DABC."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The sequence of the sentences is organized to provide a coherent and logical flow of information about the topic of spam on the internet:

 
 
• 
 
**Introduction to Spam (Sentence D)**: The paragraph begins with a definition and explanation of what spam is, setting the stage for the topic.

 
 
• 
 
Acknowledging the Problem (Sentence A): The last sentence broadens the perspective by stating that the seemingly harmless activities of a small number of people are becoming a serious problem for the internet, tying back to the initial explanation of spam.

 
 
• 
 
**Personal Experience with Spam (Sentence B)**: The second sentence engages the reader by asking a question about their personal experience with spam, specifically mentioning 'junk mail' in email boxes.

 
 
• 
 
**Detailed Explanation of Spam (Sentence C)**: Following the introduction and personal connection, the paragraph provides more details about what spam entails, describing it as electronic junk mail or junk newsgroup postings.

 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 4.

 ​
 
• Correct sequence:

D. Spam is the flooding of the internet with many copies of the same message, in an attempt to force the message on people who would not otherwise choose to receive it.

A. The so-called harmless activities of a small number of people are increasingly becoming a serious problem for the internet.

B. You would have seen an increasing amount of 'junk mail' showing up in your email box.

questions.question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The flowers were being plucked by the children in the garden.

options.text: The children were plucking the flowers in the garden.
The children are plucking the flowers in the garden.
The children had been plucking the flowers in the garden.
The children was plucking the flowers in the garden.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** ****"****The children were plucking the flowers in the garden."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **Past Continuous Tense **and in** Passive Voice.**
 
• The rule for changing a **Past Continuous Tense** from Active voice to Passive voice or Passive to Active Voice:
 
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• **Structure: **
 
 
• **Subject + was/were + v1 + ing + object (Active Voice)__**
 
• **Object + was/were + being + V3 + by Subject __(Passive Voice)__ **
 
 
 
• **Example: **
 
 
• *Esha was singing a song.** ***(Active Voice)**
 
• *A song was being sung by Esha.**** *(Passive Voice)****​​**
 
 
 
 
 
• **The subject** of the given sentence is 'Flowers**'.​​**
 
• **The object** of the given sentence is** 'children.' **
 
• **The subject** will be put in place of** the object **and** the object **will be put in place of **the subject.**
 
• **'Were being plucked'** will be changed into **'were plucking'. **
 
• **"Children"** is a plural subject so we must **"were"** with it.
 
• The correct option 1 follows all the above rules and correctly expresses the given sentence in active voice.
